messages.author: e1656d208b1207ce
messages.subject: dvipng support
parts:
Hi Shinyapps dev team,

In my app I needed to convert Latex to png on the fly and I found the easiest way to do that was to use something like 

sys("dvipng file.dvi")

which requires the program "dvipng". It works well on my local Windows machine, but I got an error message after I deployed it to Shinyapps.io. Is there a way you can install dvipng on the server?

Thanks,
Yindeng

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] dvipng support
parts:
Yindeng,
We unfortunately don't have dvipng installed on our servers.  I will add it to our backlog, but I am not sure about the time it will take to add support for it.  
I will ask internally if there is another package that you can use to achieve your desired outcome.

-Tareef

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] dvipng support
parts:
You can draw plots with LaTeX expressions using the tikzDevice
package, but it only gives you PDF output, in which case you still
have to convert PDF to PNG to display it on the web page. ImageMagick
might do it, but it is not installed on ShinyApps.

I'm not sure if you have looked at demo('plotmath'), which provides
another way to write LaTeX math in R plots, and it does not require
any additional software packages.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: e1656d208b1207ce
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] dvipng support
parts:
Thanks for the ideas. Let me provide a little more context on what I'm trying to achieve. Basically I'd like to render the results of the "tabular" function in package "tables" in shiny. The ideal approach is to convert the tabular object to html, which in theory is what the generic function "html" does, but it appears like a lot of features in the "tables" package are not supported by "html". On the other hand, "latex" supports all features, and I can easily generate a dvi or PDF file from latex. The problem is, I can't figure out a way to embed dvi or PDF in a web page with shiny (I tried renderImage); besides, an embedded PDF doesn't look nice anyway. That's how it led me to use "dvipng" to convert dvi to png to be used with renderImage. Hope that clarifies my question and I'm open to suggestions.

Thanks,
Yindeng
